data.narrative:
Loyal is a Series C–stage biotech company that has raised $250M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with the most directly comparable private companies being Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $250M total raised as a proxy starting point and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $425M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue data for the target.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $361M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The substantial spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around market positioning relative to peers. Stage-progression implies conservative end of the range, while peer-median reflects significant upside sensitivity to whether Loyal tracks closer to the median or higher-performing comparables. Key uncertainties include clinical stage, intellectual property strength, and revenue trajectory relative to named peers.
